part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the enum `to_json` overload: it funneled the enum value through `external_constructor<value_t::number_integer>::construct`, which takes `number_integer_t` (int64_t), so enums with unsigned 64-bit underlying types got reinterpreted as negative signed values.

Changes:
- `include/nlohmann/detail/conversions/to_json.hpp:323` — replaced the broken 220-line implementation with the correct form: `j = static_cast<underlying_type>(e);`, which dispatches through the generic `to_json` overloads so unsigned underlying types produce `number_unsigned` and signed ones produce `number_integer` (also removed the now-unneeded includes added by the broken block).
- `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp:5700` — same one-line fix for the amalgamated header.

Validation:
- The issue's repro (`book_id : uint64_t` with value `1 << 63`) now serializes to `9223372036854775808`, is `is_number_unsigned()`, and round-trips correctly; `0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFE` → `18446744073709551614`; signed enums still serialize as negative.
- `test-udt_cpp11` (11 cases / 70 assertions) and `test-conversions_cpp11` pass; all other runnable unit test binaries pass. The only failures in the full suite are environmental — tests gated on `download_test_data`, which cannot run without network access (they fail identically regardless of this change).
